records.displayTitle: CLASH OF THE CHAMPIONS V – ST. VALENTINE’S DAY MASSACRE
records.summary: Clash of the Champions V took place on February 15, 1989 at the Cleveland Convention Center in Cleveland, Ohio. There were 5,000 people in attendance and the show drew a 4.6 rating on TBS. This show was warm up show for the Chi-Town Rumble PPV only 5 days later.

CLASH OF THE CHAMPIONS IX – NEW YORK KNOCKOUT
records.displayTitle: CLASH OF THE CHAMPIONS IX – NEW YORK KNOCKOUT
records.summary: WCW Clash of The Champions IX: New York Knockout took place on November 15, 1989 at The Houston Field House in Troy, New York. There were 4,000 fans in attendance and the show drew a 4.9 rating on TBS. This show mainly dealt with fallout from Halloween Havoc PPV and set up the Iron Man/Iron Team tournaments at Starrcade '89: Future Shock.
